notes: Rule strings are OoTR's, unchanged except that comments were dropped and whitespace collapsed exactly as OoTR's own loader (Utils.read_logic_file) does, then trimmed.
Rule language = a Python expression subset interpreted by raw/semantics/RuleParser.py.
locations[*].default: chest/collectible flag, or (room, scene setup, actor index) tuples for pots/crates/freestanding/wonderitems; meaning depends on type (see LocationList.py header).
locations[*].n64_rom_addresses are N64 ROM offsets (useless for the remake; kept for completeness).
regions[*].area is the dungeon, else the hint area, else (area_inferred) the nearest hint area reached by walking incoming exits backwards.
MQ dungeons only. Combine with Overworld/Bosses regions, helpers, items and tricks from logic.json.
